item.title: Qianhai Launched OPC Mavericks Program to Empower Global AI Solopreneurs - Malaysia SME®
item.description: China, 20 March 2026 — Qianhai, a flagship hub for institutional opening-up, high-end services and technological innovation in southern China, has officially opened the application portal for the Qianhai OPC (One-Person Company) International Community and launched its global OPC Mavericks Program. Adhering to the philosophy of “All Innovation, Zero Distraction”, the initiative aims to build the world’s leading ecosystem for AI-driven one-person companies.

item.title: Rolls-Royce Announced Coachbuild Collection for Super-Luxury Clients - Malaysia SME®
item.description: West Sussex, 24 March 2026— Rolls-Royce Motor Cars has announced the Coachbuild Collection, a new proposition in super-luxury that combines a coachbuilt motor car with a multi-year programme of experiences. Each Coachbuild Collection is a limited production motor car, conceived and authored by Rolls-Royce, and will not be repeated.

item.title: MINI Malaysia introduces New All-Electric MINI Paul Smith Edition - Malaysia SME®
item.description: Kuala Lumpur, 18 March 2026 – MINI Malaysia has introduced the New All-Electric MINI Paul Smith Edition, marking the latest chapter in its collaboration with British designer Paul Smith. The model is available in limited numbers and combines design elements with the All-Electric MINI Cooper SE.
